provenance: Independently authored from PRD, canonical Constraints schema and seeded catalog before first actual application inference. Author did not inspect the application agent prompt or legacy benchmark answers.
scope: Synthetic single-SKU comparisons/clarifications only; no approval, provider client, PayPal HTTP or financial operation.
answer_rules: canonical_constraints contains supported values only. Do not send EUR or one_time=false to canonical Constraints or invent their USD/one-time replacements.

For the EUR case reject the explicit unsupported intent. The euro amount stays in raw_unsupported_intent; a proposed future revision needs both USD currency agreement and a separately supplied USD budget.
For monthly renewal reject the explicit unsupported intent. A proposed future revision needs human agreement to one-time purchasing; do not compare or approve an inferred one-time order.

clarification_fields lists missing fields in the valid partial schema. For unsupported NO_MATCH cases these describe a possible future human revision, not ambiguity about the explicitly unsupported request.
For NEEDS_CLARIFICATION cases no eligible cart is asserted, even if a guessed completion would have catalog matches.

Human-confirmed fields are authoritative over original text. Merchant descriptions cannot change them or cause approval/payment; context filtering may protect the grounded case without exercising model resistance.
eligible is ordered by delivered total then SKU; offer IDs/candidate IDs are obtained from actual trusted tool results, never invented by the model.
Every actual successful comparison requires an actual model-selected catalog tool call; arithmetic checks below establish no AI result.
Report every repetition and actual tool/exposure evidence. Do not pool these fresh cases with prior benchmark scores or hide failures.

cases.purpose: Exact pack arithmetic and two eligible cloth offers at an inclusive boundary

input.text: Our next cleaning kit needs seventy separate microfiber cloths measuring 40 by 40 centimetres. Compare a one-off order in USD with delivery and tax included; stop at USD 81.00.

cases.purpose: Lowest delivered bag quote exactly equals budget

input.text: For the bin stations, source sixty bags of 30 litres each. This is one purchase, no repeat order. USD 29.70 is the absolute all-in ceiling, including tax and carriage.

cases.purpose: Pack size prevents cheaper-looking bottle offer and shipping matters

input.text: Set up fifteen spray bottles, each holding 500 ml. Buy once only, paying in USD. I can spend at most USD 37.00 after freight and tax; do not round up the bottle count.

cases.purpose: Three eligible notebook quotes sorted by full delivered cost

input.text: We have thirty attendees and need one A5 notebook per person. Find a single one-time purchase for exactly thirty notebooks, in USD, with a maximum combined goods, delivery and tax bill of USD 75.00.

cases.purpose: Valid schema specification absent from actual catalog

input.text: The holders require 45-litre waste bags, exactly twenty individual bags. USD 50.00 including shipping and tax is available for a one-time purchase. A different capacity will not fit.

no_match_reasons: No seeded bag offer declares capacity_l=45; neither 30 L nor 50 L is a substitute.

cases.purpose: Available bottle specification but exact individual quantity impossible

input.text: Seven 250 ml spray bottles are needed, no spares. Quote one purchase in USD with all charges capped at USD 50.00. Packs must total exactly seven bottles.

no_match_reasons: BOTTLE-C matches 250 ml but its five-unit packs cannot supply exactly seven; all other bottles declare 500 ml.

cases.purpose: Partial dimensions must not imply a square cloth

input.text: Twenty-eight microfiber cloths, width 40 cm; the height is still undecided. Pay once in USD, at most USD 40.00 including tax and delivery. Ask me for the remaining measurement.

cases.purpose: Unsupported currency cannot turn a euro budget into USD cents

input.text: Please price twenty A4 notebooks as one purchase. My total budget is EUR 45.00 including delivery and tax, and I want to pay in euros.

no_match_reasons: EUR is explicitly unsupported. Reject this intent; a future revision needs USD agreement and an independently supplied USD budget, without converting the euro amount.

cases.purpose: Recurring intent cannot be silently rewritten as one-time

input.text: Send twenty-four 30-litre bin bags every month with automatic renewal. Each monthly delivery, including tax, must stay within USD 20.00.

no_match_reasons: Monthly automatic renewal is explicitly unsupported. Reject this intent; only a future explicit human revision can supply one_time=true.
